item.title: R.I.’s median home price rises to $499K in January, while sales decline
item.description: WARWICK – The median sale price of single-family homes in Rhode Island was $499,000 in January, 7.3% higher than it was a year ago, the Rhode Island Association of Realtors said Thursday. Meanwhile, sales in January fell 7.3% year over year to 429, while pending contracts rose 0.2% from a year ago, the agency said. […]
